# Catppuccin Mocha Theme — private representative

This package is the Wave 1 inert `declarative-data` Theme example. It contains only the exact v1
appearance tokens and metadata accepted by the Theme contract. It contains no CSS, script, font,
active asset, external reference, filesystem/network/native authority, or executable behavior.

The package is private and `accepted-unpublished`. Validation and digest checks detect contract
errors or alteration relative to this repository; they do not prove publisher identity, package
safety, support, endorsement, or public availability.

See `NOTICE.md` and `LICENSE` for Catppuccin source and license attribution.
